title: VERIFY T-472: a claimant cannot choose the observed value
acceptance_criteria: Try to file a false claim through every argument file_claim and its CLI accept; none may move the observed value. Mutants in throwaway copies: let a caller argument override the reader; let a parameter with no reader fall through to a default; drop the per-parameter direction (exceeds versus differs). Each must fail at least one test.
Read each reader against the record it reads and confirm it is tied to the commit act's own task. Full suite, then verdict.
